(i) mutant SOD1 forms toxic heterodimers with wild-type SOD1, (ii) the aggregation potential of SOD1(G8R) is not sufficient to cause toxicity, and (iii) the dismutase activity of SOD1 heterodimers is not sufficient to prevent toxicity.
(i) SOD1(G93A) homodimers are not toxic, but heterodimer formation of SOD1(G86R) and SOD1(hwt) is toxic; and (ii) toxicity of mutant heterodimers does not correlate with their aggregation potential.
